session: Background photos for volunteer roles
text: A personal file (a headshot and its manifest) under .codeyam/design/user_files/ was untracked before the session began. stage-feature listed it under stagedInternal and staged it. After I unstaged it, commit-state committed it again in its automatic 'chore: update codeyam state' commit. I caught it before the push, but a raw amend was refused at the push slug. I had to undo the unpushed commit with git reset --soft and add the folder to .git/info/exclude so it would not be picked up again.
mechanism: pre-existing untracked .codeyam files are auto-committed with codeyam state
